title: chat.php rate response
description: HTTP 200 body for action=rate: the rating is stored (a second rating by the same user on the same summary replaces the first). Built by PanelPayload::rated(). A cache_key that is not one of the session patient's cached briefings is 409 with chat.error.response.

correlation_id.description: This rate request's own correlation id.

comment_saved.description: True when a non-empty comment was stored with the rating.
